task: A learning platform's team wants to know who is making progress, which courses get finished and which learners have gone quiet. Its activity export lists every try at every lesson, but it was re-run once and some rows can't be placed in time. Build a pipeline that cleans the attempts, tracks each learner through each course, measures completion against a stated denominator and lists inactive learners, all as of one fixed day, with checks that the numbers add up.
problems: About 2% of attempt rows are exact copies from a re-run export.
Learners retry lessons, so one lesson can have several attempts.
Some attempts were abandoned: no score, and passed is false.
Some learners signed up and never attempted anything.
revenue: Every number is measured as of 2026-06-28, the last day of the data, set once in the file as AS_OF_DATE and never taken from today's date. A course's completion rate is its learners who passed every lesson (lessons passed equals the course's lesson count) out of its enrolled learners: everyone with at least one clean attempt in the course. A learner is inactive with no clean attempt in the 30 days up to and including the as-of date.
